title: Git Quotes
text:
: ## 1st Approach
git clone \<online-repo-url\>

### If made any change locally then run:

git add -A

git commit -m "comt"

git push
: ## 2nd Approach - from Local to remote
git init \<directory-name\>

git add -A

git commit -m "msg"

ssh-keygen -t rsa -b 1024 -C "Email\@e.com"

If file name you give is testkey then locate it and cat testkey.pub

-   go to github.com/\<repo\> ; Click user icon and then select setting

-   select ssh and gpg keys

-   select new ssh key and paste above testkey.pub
git remote add origin https://github.com/abidalishaikh/<repo>


git init
git add -A
git commit -m “message”
git remote add origin https://github.com/abidalishaikh/<repo>
git push -u origin master

title: WebScrapping
text:
Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see https://quarto.org.

#loading Libraries
library(xml2)
library(httr)
library(rvest)

r <- read_html("https://datatrail-jhu.github.io/stable_website/webscrape.html")
s <- html_nodes(r,"strong")
t <- html_text(s)
print(t)

title: WebScrapping
text:
Running Code
When you click the Render button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

1 + 1

[1] 2


You can add options to executable code like this


[1] 4


The echo: false option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
